component.name: Card
component.description: The board's primary content unit — one run per card, its meta, description, tags, and an optional Approve footer.

commonPatterns.name: board-card
commonPatterns.description: A run card inside a Column, opening the detail Dialog on click.
commonPatterns.composition: <Card title="Meter — low step" meta="run-42" description="..." tags={<Badge variant="running">Running</Badge>} footer={<Button appearance="approve-ghost">Approve</Button>} onClick={openDetail} />

antiPatterns.scenario: Using Card as a generic content box
antiPatterns.reason: its padding and slot anatomy is specific to the board item shape
antiPatterns.alternative: Use a plain div with surface-card background for generic boxed content

antiPatterns.scenario: Nesting a second surface-inset box inside the description
antiPatterns.reason: surface-inset is reserved for the description well only
antiPatterns.alternative: Use surface-card or a plain container for other nested content

slots.footer: ReactNode, optional — renders the divider only when present

parentConstraints: Meant to live inside a Column's card stack

states: hover (adds inset ring, no background change)

interactions.click: opens the run detail page when onClick is provided

accessibility.role: button (only when onClick is provided — otherwise a plain div)
accessibility.screenReader: the 4-line description clamp must not be the only way to read the full text — link to the full detail view

aiHints.context: Use inside Column to represent one board item. Pass onClick to open the run detail Dialog.
